keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 macro nature photo at the wet muddy edge of a flooded rice paddy in soft morning light. One small flat grey stone sits in the center of the frame, surrounded by very shallow still clear water. Young green rice stems and a mud bank are softly blurred in the background. The camera is placed low at the level of the stone, looking slightly up. On the stone stands one adult female rice field crab, seen from the front three-quarter view and slightly from below, facing a little to the left. She has a smooth rounded dark olive-brown carapace, two claws and eight walking legs, and she stands high on her legs so her underside is visible. Her broad rounded abdominal flap is folded under her body but pushed slightly open by a dense mass of a few hundred small round amber-yellow eggs, held under the flap on her small abdominal legs. The eggs bulge out and are clearly visible along the edge of the flap. The eggs are only under the flap, none on the stone. The crab with her legs is about half of the frame width, in the center. Keep everything important away from the left and right edges. Only one crab. No text, no watermark.

No text, no watermark.
